mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_feedback (message_id, helpful, source, create_time) VALUES (#{messageId}, #{helpful}, #{source}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ai_feedback WHERE message_id = #{messageId} AND source = #{source}
mapper.select: SELECT f.message_id AS messageId, f.helpful, f.source FROM ai_feedback f INNER JOIN ai_chat_message m ON m.id = f.message_id WHERE m.session_id = #{sessionId} AND m.user_id = #{userId} AND f.source = 'CHAT'

SELECT f.message_id AS messageId, f.helpful, f.source FROM ai_feedback f INNER JOIN agent_conversation_message m ON m.id = f.message_id WHERE m.conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND f.source = 'AGENT'
